read.thesis: Accenture Q1 FY26 revenue $18.7B (+5% LC, top of range) with bookings $20.9B (book-to-bill 1.1), but FY guide held at 2-5% LC and Advanced AI metrics are being discontinued.

triggers.label: Advanced AI metrics discontinued
triggers.quote: This will be the last quarter in which we share these specific metrics.

triggers.label: Contract profitability improving on pricing
triggers.quote: we're starting to see some of that improved pricing, show up in the P and L

triggers.label: Bookings +10% LC, book-to-bill 1.1
triggers.quote: representing 12% growth in U.S. Dollars and 10% growth in local currency with an overall book to bill of 1.1

triggers.label: FY26 LC growth 2-5% maintained
triggers.quote: we continue to expect revenue to be in the range of 2% to 5% growth in local currency over fiscal 2025

guidance.quote: we continue to expect revenue to be in the range of 2% to 5% growth in local currency over fiscal 2025
we continue to expect fiscal year 2026 to be 15.7% to 15.9%
we continue to expect our full year adjusted diluted earnings per share for fiscal 2026 to be in the range of $13.52 to $13.90
free cash flow to be in the range of $9.8 billion to $10.5 billion
we expect revenues to be in the range of $17.35 billion to $18 billion
We continue to expect to return at least $9.3 billion through dividends and share repurchases

red_flags.label: Day sales outstanding up to 51 days
red_flags.quote: Day services outstanding were fifty-one days, compared to forty-seven days last quarter and fifty days in the first quarter of last year.

red_flags.label: Discretionary spend not recovering
red_flags.quote: we haven't seen a change in the market

It's our 2% to 5% really reflects what we see going for the remainder of the fiscal year.
